observations: Line 3 computes `left - right` using int subtraction, which can overflow for extreme operand values.
Probe p1: compare(Integer.MIN_VALUE, 1) evaluates MIN_VALUE - 1, which overflows to Integer.MAX_VALUE, so signum returns 1 (positive) although left < right.
This violates the stated contract that the result must be negative when left < right.
Probe p2: compare(3, 3) evaluates 3 - 3 = 0, so signum returns 0, matching the equality requirement.
No static findings are reported, so the overflow defect is only observable at runtime with extreme inputs.
The method is static and package-private, so it is directly callable as shown in the probes.
